description: PROVEN (fz-k22.10 spike 5 final, wt-k22-root @ 93fe12d68). The proximate 4-vs-5 arithmetic: BoundaryId(56) surface = 2 SEMANTIC inputs [Ty(21),Ty(440)] = 3 arg LANES (the accumulator Ty(440) is a 2-lane shape). The declared cranelift signature counts lanes: build_fn_sigs -> build_fn_signature(closure_target.arg_reprs) (native_codegen/driver.rs:126-136) = 3+self+cont = 5. But push_direct_closure_args (native_codegen/terminator.rs:164-181) iterates args.iter().enumerate() pushing ONE ABI arg per SEMANTIC arg (target.arg_reprs.get(i)) = 2+self+cont = 4 -> got 4 expected 5, silently mis-coercing reprs along the way. ANY closure-lit direct call whose surface has a multi-lane input under-fills. Standalone, concrete, testable: a closure direct call with a multi-lane (e.g. 2-lane tuple/accumulator) input. NOTE: fixing this alone changes WHICH mismatch fires (the boundary surface vs target compiled ABI divergence remains, see sibling tickets) -- but per-lane arg pushing is correct regardless and must land.

comments.text: IMPLEMENTED on epic branch @ 1279a3e4d (close at fold). KEY DISCOVERY reshaping the ticket: at native-codegen time each semantic arg is ALREADY collapsed to one scalar CodegenValue (every ArgRepr::abi_arity()==1; CodegenValue wraps exactly one ir::Value — value.rs:180). The multi-lane pieces exist only at IR-CONSTRUCTION time (encode_runtime_value_for_position, jobs/native.rs) -- there is nothing left to project from at the codegen layer, and building a decoder+width-bookkeeping there would be a second lane-expansion mechanism (rejected per tight-changes). LANDED: require_direct_closure_call_arity_agreement (surface.rs, same idiom + shared incompatible_physical_abi_message prose) fails clean BEFORE under-filling; the silent target.arg_reprs.get(i).unwrap_or(ValueRef) mis-coercion default replaced by direct index (provably in-bounds after the guard). push_direct_closure_args -> Result, both emit sites propagate. +2 tests. lib 1328/0/6 (also --release), clippy clean, matrix md5-identical pre/post (74 names on this branch), both target fixtures unchanged (die at earlier guards). RESIDUAL (rides fz-k22.18): a direct-callable closure whose surface has a multi-lane semantic arg is UNCALLABLE at codegen by construction -- the upstream fix must ensure direct-consumed surfaces are 1-value-per-semantic-arg or decompose at IR-construction; k22.18 acceptance should include the arity guard never firing on legitimate code.

title: fz-k22: push_direct_closure_args pushes one ABI arg per SEMANTIC arg while the declared sig counts LANES -- multi-lane inputs under-fill the call (unit conflation)
